description: Taking the inverse-image theory of a Boolean filter on formula classes and then its associated filter returns that filter.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.filter_theory_inverse.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (F : Order.PFilter (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.FormulaAlgebra α)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.filterOfTheory
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.theoryOfFilter F) ⋯ =
    F
